About Me

Building stronger minds for better performance.

I am Shamil Bin Ashraf, a Sports Psychologist and Consultant Psychologist focused on helping athletes and individuals understand the psychological side of performance, wellbeing and personal growth.

My work brings together sports psychology, counselling, performance-focused interventions and practical psychological skills. I support athletes with areas such as confidence, attention and focus, competition pressure, motivation, emotional regulation, self-awareness, performance preparation and recovery from psychological challenges.

Through academic training and hands-on exposure at Guru Nanak Dev University and the Sports Authority of India, Trivandrum, I have gained experience working in structured sporting environments and interacting with athletes, coaches and multidisciplinary support staff.

“Performance is not only about what the body can do; it is also about how the mind prepares, responds and adapts.”
— Shamil
Vision & Mission

Developing the psychological foundation of the next generation.

Sports psychology can help athletes understand themselves, manage performance demands, build sustainable mental skills and approach challenges with greater awareness.

01

Vision

To contribute to a sporting culture where psychological wellbeing and mental preparation are treated as an integral part of athlete development, from emerging athletes to high-performance environments.

02

Mission

To provide accessible, ethical and practical psychological support through counselling, education, assessment and performance-focused interventions that help athletes and individuals understand their minds and develop useful psychological skills.

What I Provide

Services designed around the person behind the performance.

Support can be individual, group-based or educational depending on the needs of the athlete, team, institution or individual.

Counselling

Counselling support for athletes and general individuals around personal, emotional and performance-related concerns.

Workshops

Interactive workshops for academies, schools, colleges, coaches, athletes and sports organisations.

Assessment

Psychological assessment and structured screening to understand selected performance and psychological variables.

Individual & Group Sessions

Practical sessions covering self-awareness, confidence, attention, focus, stress management, imagery, self-talk and performance preparation.
